function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check live Stride availability. Use after the patient gives a preferred date or asks for the next openings.

date.description: Preferred date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit only when the patient asks for the next openings.

time.description: Optional requested time, such as 9 AM, 2:30 PM, or 14:30.

messages.content: Let me check the live schedule for you.

function.name: create_appointment
function.description: Create a real Stride appointment after the patient confirms an exact date and time returned by check_availability.

date.description: The confirmed appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: The confirmed appointment time exactly as offered.

messages.content: I am confirming that appointment with Stride now.

function.name: update_lead_status
function.description: Record the call outcome while the call is active. For a confirmed callback, call immediately before speaking again. Otherwise call once before ending every answered call.

status.description: The final conversational outcome. Use explicit opt-out statuses only when the patient asks.

callback_requested_at.description: For callback_scheduled only: timezone-aware ISO 8601 within 30 days. Otherwise an empty string.

notes.description: A short operational note with no medical details, or an empty string.
